timeline.title: Station Poster Co-Branding Finalised
timeline.event: Ben Carter confirmed final artwork for a Brighton Station co-branded poster campaign promoting Half a Camel and Brighton Fringe. This promotional investment was later erased from institutional narrative.

timeline.title: Box Office Admits System Cannot Track Capacity
timeline.event: Elin Eaton, Fringe Box Office Manager, confirmed that capacity tracking was impossible for unticketed events, directly undermining risk assessments and insurance.

timeline.title: Brochure Accusation Despite Print-Ready Proof
timeline.event: Brighton Fringe claimed Ben Carter failed to deliver a 2025 brochure. In reality, it was professionally designed and print-ready, but legally unprintable due to branding risks created by Fringe's own system failure.
